name: subtitle-translator-monorepo
description: Tradutor de legendas .srt (Angular + API Express) publicado como um único projeto na Vercel

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace packages/backend" "npm start --workspace packages/frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --workspace packages/backend && npm test --workspace packages/frontend -- --watch=false --browsers=ChromeHeadless
